summary.english: A boy learns to count to ten with the help of a girl.
summary.chinese: 一个男孩在一个女孩的帮助下学会数到十。
summary.pinyin: Yí ge nánhái zài yí ge nǚhái de bāngzhù xià xuéhuì shǔ dào shí.

segments.english: I am a boy.
segments.pinyin: Wǒ shì nánhái.

segments.english: I want to count to ten.
segments.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng shǔ dào shí.

segments.english: I cannot count to ten.
segments.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng shǔ dào shí.

segments.english: I want to learn.
segments.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xuéxí.

segments.english: I go outside.
segments.pinyin: Wǒ qù wàimiàn.

segments.english: I see a girl.
segments.pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn yí ge nǚhái.

segments.english: The girl has a book.
segments.pinyin: Nǚhái yǒu yì běn shū.

segments.english: The book has numbers.
segments.pinyin: Shū yǒu shùzì.

segments.english: I want to look at the book.
segments.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kàn shū.

segments.english: I say, "Can I look at the book?"
segments.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: “Wǒ néng kàn shū ma?”

segments.english: The girl says, "Yes. Look."
segments.pinyin: Nǚhái shuō: “Kěyǐ. Kàn ba.”

segments.english: I look at the book.
segments.pinyin: Wǒ kàn shū.

segments.english: I see one. I see two. I see three.
segments.chinese: 我看见一。我看见二。我看见三。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn yī. Wǒ kànjiàn èr. Wǒ kànjiàn sān.
segments.audioText: 我看见一。我看见二。我看见三。

segments.english: I go to a tree.
segments.pinyin: Wǒ qù yì kē shù.

segments.english: I sit at the tree.
segments.pinyin: Wǒ zài shù pángbiān zuò.

segments.english: I look at one. I have one tree. I say, "One."
segments.chinese: 我看一。我有一棵树。我说：“一。”
segments.pinyin: Wǒ kàn yī. Wǒ yǒu yì kē shù. Wǒ shuō: “Yī.”
segments.audioText: 我看一。我有一棵树。我说：“一。”

segments.english: I go to the girl. I say, "I have one."
segments.chinese: 我去女孩那里。我说：“我有一。”
segments.pinyin: Wǒ qù nǚhái nàlǐ. Wǒ shuō: “Wǒ yǒu yī.”
segments.audioText: 我去女孩那里。我说：“我有一。”

segments.english: The girl has two apples.
segments.pinyin: Nǚhái yǒu liǎng ge píngguǒ.

segments.english: I look at two. I eat one apple. The girl eats one apple. I say, "Two."
segments.chinese: 我看二。我吃一个苹果。女孩吃一个苹果。我说：“二。”
segments.pinyin: Wǒ kàn èr. Wǒ chī yí ge píngguǒ. Nǚhái chī yí ge píngguǒ. Wǒ shuō: “Èr.”
segments.audioText: 我看二。我吃一个苹果。女孩吃一个苹果。我说：“二。”

segments.english: I go to a shop. I buy three. I have three. I say, "Three."
segments.chinese: 我去商店。我买三。我有三。我说：“三。”
segments.pinyin: Wǒ qù shāngdiàn. Wǒ mǎi sān. Wǒ yǒu sān. Wǒ shuō: “Sān.”
segments.audioText: 我去商店。我买三。我有三。我说：“三。”

segments.english: I sit at the tree. I look at the book. The girl comes.
segments.chinese: 我在树旁边坐。我看书。女孩来了。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ zài shù pángbiān zuò. Wǒ kàn shū. Nǚhái lái le.
segments.audioText: 我在树旁边坐。我看书。女孩来了。

segments.english: I say, "I know one, two, three."
segments.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: “Wǒ zhīdào yī, èr, sān.”

segments.english: The girl says, "I have four, five, six."
segments.pinyin: Nǚhái shuō: “Wǒ yǒu sì, wǔ, liù.”

segments.english: I say, "I want to know four."
segments.pinyin: Wǒ shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào sì.”

segments.english: The girl says, "I can say four."
segments.pinyin: Nǚhái shuō: “Wǒ néng shuō sì.”

segments.english: I listen. I say, "Four." I say, "Five." I say, "Six."
segments.chinese: 我听。我说：“四。”我说：“五。”我说：“六。”
segments.pinyin: Wǒ tīng. Wǒ shuō: “Sì.” Wǒ shuō: “Wǔ.” Wǒ shuō: “Liù.”
segments.audioText: 我听。我说：“四。”我说：“五。”我说：“六。”

segments.english: I go to the shop. I buy seven. I have seven. I say, "Seven."
segments.chinese: 我去商店。我买七。我有七。我说：“七。”
segments.pinyin: Wǒ qù shāngdiàn. Wǒ mǎi qī. Wǒ yǒu qī. Wǒ shuō: “Qī.”
segments.audioText: 我去商店。我买七。我有七。我说：“七。”

segments.english: I go to the tree. I see eight birds. I say, "Eight."
segments.chinese: 我去树那里。我看见八只鸟。我说：“八。”
segments.pinyin: Wǒ qù shù nàlǐ. Wǒ kànjiàn bā zhī niǎo. Wǒ shuō: “Bā.”
segments.audioText: 我去树那里。我看见八只鸟。我说：“八。”

segments.english: The girl has nine. I look at nine. I say, "Nine."
segments.chinese: 女孩有九。我看九。我说：“九。”
segments.pinyin: Nǚhái yǒu jiǔ. Wǒ kàn jiǔ. Wǒ shuō: “Jiǔ.”
segments.audioText: 女孩有九。我看九。我说：“九。”

segments.english: I have ten. The girl has ten apples. I eat ten apples. I say, "Ten."
segments.chinese: 我有十。女孩有十个苹果。我吃十个苹果。我说：“十。”
segments.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shí. Nǚhái yǒu shí ge píngguǒ. Wǒ chī shí ge píngguǒ. Wǒ shuō: “Shí.”
segments.audioText: 我有十。女孩有十个苹果。我吃十个苹果。我说：“十。”

segments.english: I can count to ten.
segments.pinyin: Wǒ néng shǔ dào shí.

segments.english: I like the girl. The girl likes me.
segments.chinese: 我喜欢女孩。女孩喜欢我。
segments.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan nǚhái. Nǚhái xǐhuan wǒ.
segments.audioText: 我喜欢女孩。女孩喜欢我。

segments.english: We sit at the tree. We eat apples.
segments.chinese: 我们在树旁边坐。我们吃苹果。
segments.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shù pángbiān zuò. Wǒmen chī píngguǒ.
segments.audioText: 我们在树旁边坐。我们吃苹果。

source.approvedEnglish:
A Boy and a Girl

I am a boy. I want to count to ten. I cannot count to ten. I want to learn.

I go outside. I see a girl. The girl has a book. The book has numbers. I want to look at the book.

I say, "Can I look at the book?"  
The girl says, "Yes. Look."  
I look at the book. I see one. I see two. I see three.

I go to a tree. I sit at the tree. I look at one. I have one tree. I say, "One."  
I go to the girl. I say, "I have one."

The girl has two apples. I look at two. I eat one apple. The girl eats one apple. I say, "Two."  
I go to a shop. I buy three. I have three. I say, "Three."

I sit at the tree. I look at the book. The girl comes.  
I say, "I know one, two, three."  
The girl says, "I have four, five, six."  
I say, "I want to know four."  
The girl says, "I can say four."  
I listen. I say, "Four." I say, "Five." I say, "Six."

I go to the shop. I buy seven. I have seven. I say, "Seven."  
I go to the tree. I see eight birds. I say, "Eight."  
The girl has nine. I look at nine. I say, "Nine."  
I have ten. The girl has ten apples. I eat ten apples. I say, "Ten."

I can count to ten. I like the girl. The girl likes me. We sit at the tree. We eat apples.
